an5.121:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an5.121:1.2: Atha kho Bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena gilānasālā ten' upasaṅkami.
an5.121:1.3: Addasā kho Bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ dubbalaṃ gilānakaṃ,
an5.121:2.1: Yaṃ kiñci bhikkhave dubbalaṃ gilānakaṃ pañca dhammā na vijahanti, tass'etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ:
an5.121:2.2: na cirass' eva āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissati.
an5.121:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu asubhānupassī kāye viharati, āhāre paṭikkūlasaññī, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññī, sabbasaṅkhāresu aniccānupassī, maraṇasaññā kho pan'assa ajjhattaṃ supaṭṭhitā hoti.
an5.121:3.3: Yaṃ kiñci bhikkhave dubbalaṃ gilānakaṃ ime pañca dhammā na vijahanti, tass'etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ:
an5.121:3.4: na cirass' eva āsavānaṃ khayā . . . pe . . . sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissatī
